content:
Priya Patel: quick handoff — wrapping up day, leaving context for night
incident-bot: Pager triggered (P2) — router-429-spike — 1767811200
Alex Chen: morning spike ~09:20UTC, ingress 429s on streaming router, affected ~2% of requests for ~7m
Samira Gomez: digging — saw connection queue growth on node pool 'ingress-usw-2'
Marta Alvarez: we scaled pool manually and drained two flaky nodes; that reduced retry storms
Priya Patel: customer impact: intermittent degraded streaming, some clients reconnected automatically; small increase in client retries
Alex Chen: mitigation performed: increased keepalive timeout, scaled target=8 -> 12, toggled router slowpath protection
Samira Gomez: logs show upstream circuit-breaker tripping at high load; opened RNF-501 to tune cb thresholds
incident-bot: Pager resolved — router-429-spike — 1767811700
Priya Patel: separate item — embedding-indexer lagged behind for 10m after a gc spike, caused delayed embeddings for batch jobs
Marta Alvarez: indexer gc correlates with nightly compaction; moved compaction window later and reduced compaction memory throttle
Alex Chen: action: add soft-sla alert for embeddings-lag > 3m to prevent user-facing delays
Priya Patel: oncall coverage: I'm handing off at 23:00UTC. Night primary = Alex Chen (@alex), secondary = Samira Gomez (@samira). Marta will be escalation for infra
Marta Alvarez: note — I'm reachable on phone for urgent escalations. prefer @marta in slack for page triage
Alex Chen: quick checklist for night shift:
- watch /dashboards/ops/router for streaming-429 and connection-queue p95
- alerts: router-429-spike, ingress-conn-queue-high, embeddings-lag
- runbooks: https://runbooks.internal/oncall/router-429 and https://runbooks.internal/oncall/embeds-lag
Samira Gomez: handy rollback for router config:
```
rc config apply --service router --file router-stable.yaml
rc rollout pause --service router
```
Priya Patel: recent commands we ran (audit):
```
2026-03-15T09:24Z scale:ingress-usw-2 -> 12 by priya
2026-03-15T09:27Z node:drain node-5728 by marta
```
incident-bot: New incident (P3) — dedup-worker-oom — 1767815400
Alex Chen: dedup-worker saw OOMs during a high-parallel reindex job, autoscaler didn't react fast enough
Marta Alvarez: short-term fix: reduce parallelism for reindex job; longer-term: increase headroom and tune autoscaler cooldown
Samira Gomez: opened PR ops/dedup/autoscale-tune, queued for merge — will monitor after merge for 6h
Priya Patel: tonight's non-urgent items for whoever is primary:
- merge autoscale PR for dedup-worker (link: https://git.internal/rn/ops/567)
- add streaming fallback to regional-proxy as follow-up (ticket RNF-498)
- reconcile indexer compaction window with infra team
Alex Chen: escalation guidance: if router 429s persist >10m and >3% of traffic, escalate to SRE lead and exec on-call
Marta Alvarez: runbook reminder: if you need to split region manually, follow manual-region-split step in runbook (step 6) — it affects session affinity
Priya Patel: status summary for handoff email:
- router: spike resolved, watch p95 connection queue
- embeddings: transient lag, compaction window adjusted
- dedup-worker: OOMs mitigated by reducing parallelism; autoscale PR pending
Samira Gomez: leaving a short-lived debug toggle in staging to dump worker heap profiles to /tmp/heap for 12h; will remove tomorrow
Alex Chen: contact matrix: primary=@alex, secondary=@samira, escalation=@marta, SRE lead=@sre-lead
incident-bot: maintenance reminder — security kernel patches in 06h for us-west nodes
Marta Alvarez: i'll coordinate the maintenance and post a pre-window note 45m before
Priya Patel: ok thanks team. i'll be available for the first hour of night if anything breaks. logging handoff in doc: https://docs.internal/oncall/handoffs/2026-03-15
Samira Gomez: will keep an eye on dedup-worker and embeddings tonight :coffee:
Alex Chen: taking over at 23:00UTC, ping me if anything urgent. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: thread archived by incident-bot
